propositions: Bridge fsck reported four unbound Jira issues (REB-806, REB-807, REB-808, and one additional) with missing forward/reverse binding-store entries despite exact identity matches in local code_review artifacts.

Three Jira issues (REB-806, REB-807, REB-808) were correctly identified as exact duplicates of existing local code-review tickets by summary, description, revision, fingerprint, and rebar-id label, requiring binding repair rather than archival.
Binding repair was executed under rebar's unified write lock via BindingStore.bind_confirm and atomically persisted through commit_and_push_tickets_branch(strict=True).

Post-repair fsck validation confirmed all six forward/reverse binding lookups were restored, all alerting binding-drift and store_integrity findings cleared, and no spurious ticket or Jira issue mutations occurred.
